name: glass-navbar
title: Glass navbar
description: A sticky top bar on frosted glass in three styles, solid when the visitor asks for less transparency or more contrast.

props.name: current
props.description: The href of the page the visitor is on; that link gets aria-current.

props.name: action
props.description: A button or link at the end, e.g. "Book a call".

props.name: variant
props.description: frosted: a full-width bar, always glass. floating: a pill that floats clear of the edges. scroll: over the hero with white text on a soft shade, glass once the page has scrolled. Use it on a dark or photo hero; the shade keeps the text at 4.5:1 on mid-tone colours.

a11y.text: Below the sm breakpoint a menu button opens the links, and Esc closes the menu while it is open. Choosing a link closes it.

The links are in a nav labelled Main, and the link whose href equals current gets aria-current page. The menu button is named Open menu or Close menu, sets aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the menu is hidden while closed.
The background and blur transition is off under reduced motion.

The glass turns solid without backdrop-filter, with prefers-reduced-transparency and with more contrast asked for. The scroll variant keeps white text on a soft shade over the hero and turns to glass once the page has scrolled or the menu is open.
